description: Install dependencies, add required npm packages, set up project infrastructure (data storage layer, env config, NextAuth), and verify the project builds successfully.
steps: Run npm install in /projects/sandbox/VItaVerse to install existing dependencies
Install additional packages: next-auth (for authentication), qrcode @types/qrcode (for QR generation), bcryptjs @types/bcryptjs (for password hashing), uuid @types/uuid (for unique tokens)
Create .env.local.example with NEXTAUTH_SECRET, NEXTAUTH_URL, STRAVA_CLIENT_ID, STRAVA_CLIENT_SECRET

Create .env.local with placeholder values so the app can build (NEXTAUTH_SECRET=development-secret-change-me, NEXTAUTH_URL=http://localhost:3000, STRAVA_CLIENT_ID=your-strava-client-id, STRAVA_CLIENT_SECRET=your-strava-client-secret)

Create src/lib/db.ts - a file-based JSON storage utility that reads/writes to a data/ directory. Functions: readDB(collection), writeDB(collection, data), getUser(email), createUser(userData), updateUser(email, updates). Collections: users.json, challenges.json, verifications.json
Create data/ directory with empty JSON array files: users.json, challenges.json, verifications.json (each containing [])
Create src/lib/auth.ts - NextAuth configuration with CredentialsProvider (email+password). Use the db utility for user lookup. Session strategy: jwt. Include session callback to add user id.
Create src/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route.ts - the NextAuth route handler exporting GET and POST
Update src/app/layout.tsx - wrap children with a SessionProvider client component. Update metadata title to 'VitaVerse' and description to 'Fitness Challenge Verification Platform'
Create src/components/Providers.tsx - client component that wraps children with SessionProvider from next-auth/react
Update src/app/globals.css - add fitness-themed CSS custom properties (greens, blues) to the @theme inline block
Run npm run build to verify everything compiles
acceptance_criteria: npm run build succeeds without errors
.env.local.example exists with all 4 environment variables documented
src/lib/db.ts exports functions for reading/writing JSON files
data/ directory exists with users.json, challenges.json, verifications.json
